Montgomery County is Alabama's capital county, where state government, Maxwell-Gunter Air Force Base and Hyundai's assembly plant anchor employment. Downtown's civil-rights landmarks and riverfront draw steady tourism, while retail and housing growth concentrate east toward Pike Road — one of the state's fastest-growing towns.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 25, 2026
